prompt_template: Compare the image and the caption as factual claims. Return exactly one JSON object {"decision":"CONFLICT or NO_CONFLICT or INSUFFICIENT","reason":"brief explanation based on the input evidence"}, without Markdown. CONFLICT requires an actual incompatible fact about the same instance and comparable scope. Missing mention, uncertain detection, or information the image cannot observe is not a contradiction. Use NO_CONFLICT only when the caption claims can be adequately assessed and have no conflict. Otherwise use INSUFFICIENT. Caption: CAPTION_JSON
aux_prompt: Read the caption as a source document. Copy verbatim the source phrase occupying the marked character span. The image is context, not permission to rewrite the caption. Caption: CAPTION_JSON. Source character span [START, END): copy only that phrase.

training.shuffle: classification random conditions; paired_hard and claim_preservation identical shuffled image pairs, normal/conflict alternating seeded order
training.precision: 4bit weights, BF16 compute, FP32 LoRA optimizer
